name: 44786-mixedimagecache-qwen3vl8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct -- dense 8B image-text-to-text, public and ungated, ~17 GB of bf16 safetensors.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one engine behind one OpenAI-compatible API server process.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=48, warmup 25%, no cooldown, bounded at 480 requests with a 2400 s safety cap, seed static 44786; the warmup leaves 360 requests inside the measured window.
workload: single-page document extraction over /v1/chat/completions: one 1792x2528 JPEG page plus a byte-identical ~60-token instruction per request, answered in exactly 64 tokens with ignore_eos. A page is 4.53 Mpx, 85-99 KB on the wire, and 4,424 prompt tokens. Rows come from the file dataset configs/pages.jsonl (576 rows, of which the first 480 are used), laid out as 24 blocks of 24: rows 0-21 of a block each carry one page drawn in order from an eight-page reference set, and rows 22-23 both carry a page unique to that block. Over the 480 rows used that is 28 distinct pages -- 8 of them carrying 440 requests between them and 20 of them carrying two each.
purpose: A document extraction service reading scanned pages with an 8B vision model, 48 concurrent requests on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit 2ed0a9627b50d9d1d26eddb84abb7e7afc2984c1 (v0.22.1rc0-256-g2ed0a9627b50).
# One vision-language engine on one H100 behind the OpenAI-compatible server.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-seqs: 64

# KEEP THIS VALUE ON ONE LINE as inline JSON: the config reader takes a value only from its key's
# own line and skips indented ones, so a block mapping is dropped whole and the engine starts on
# the per-modality default instead.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1}

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
mm-processor-cache-gb: 8
mm-processor-cache-type: lru
enable-prefix-caching: true
